model.aux_term: corrected dp*Vdot (250 Pa fan, 0.21 MPa pump)

policy.name: water preferring economizer sequence with approach temperatures
policy.chiller: T4 = max(T4base, ceil(Twb + a_wet)), T1 = T4 + 24
policy.wet_bulb: adiabatic saturation temperature with the model's own fits

model.ladder: residual: VCAP 0.15 m3/s/kW or infeasible, max_rungs 10
model.design_rule: T4base = max(26, floor(p99.5 Twb + a_wet)+1), T1 = T4 + 24
model.states: occ_chill = chiller at design set point, occ_chill_esc = chiller with reset above it

cleaning.dedup: one per station hour: completeness, then minute circular distance, then minute
